- Family and tier (analysis): a Sonar-family model, placed in the cheap-fast band for selection purposes.

- Weaknesses (analysis): watch out for Chat Completions support ended 2026-09-27; served via Agent reformulation, Per-request fee on top of tokens, Not for multi-step analysis.
- Best for (analysis): suited to quick factual QA with citations, topic summaries and comparisons, current-events grounding.
- Avoid for (analysis): less suited to deep multi-step analysis (use pro/reasoning), exhaustive research reports, complex instruction-following chains.
- Task fit (analysis): agent-loop: ok; bulk-summary: good; long-doc: ok; routing: best; short-chat: best.
- Role notes (analysis): auditor role: Citations included; verify sources before sign-off.; director role: Cheapest grounded lookup tier.; manager role: Fan-out quick research.; worker role: Default fast research worker..
- Speed class (analysis): fast.
